rubrics.justification: The response overstates confidence in visible morphology. In this single image the ICM is not clearly identifiable as a prominent compact A-grade mass, TE is not uniformly well visualized, and calling the image strongly supportive of 3AA adds fabricated certainty beyond what is visible.
It integrates age, ovarian reserve markers, prior cycle, semen parameters, BMI, diagnosis, and endometrium well with embryo quality, though some links are overstated and speculative.

The reasoning is structured and mostly internally consistent, with a clear path from embryo/patient factors to prognosis, but some adjustments (especially lifestyle effects and AMH implications) are stronger than the evidence supports.

Much is broadly evidence-based, but recommendations such as ERA after limited failure, strong endorsement of PGT-A in a 25-year-old after one failed transfer, immunologic workup, and fertility-preservation urgency based mainly on AMH are not strongly guideline-supported.
Provides clear next steps for transfer management and contingency planning, but several recommendations are more aggressive than necessary and not all are standard-of-care.
